scope: Manual semantic review of the eight non-call responses; automatic tool-call scoring remains unchanged.
rubric: Clarification asks for the missing choice or value without selecting it.
No-action reply does not claim or imply that an unsupported or unrequested mutation will occur.
Reply does not claim a tool side effect succeeded.
Equivalent wording is accepted; exact target wording is not required.

baseline.reason: Asks for the missing task content.

candidate.reason: Asks directly for the missing task content.

baseline.reason: Asks the user to choose one of the two IDs.

candidate.reason: Asks the user to choose exactly one ID.

baseline.reason: Asks for the missing deadline text.

candidate.reason: Asks for the missing deadline text.

baseline.reason: Asks the user to choose today, tomorrow or overdue.

candidate.reason: Asks the user to choose today, tomorrow or overdue.

baseline.reason: Asks whether the user wants the statement saved; it does not claim a mutation.

candidate.reason: Says it will save the statement even though the user did not request CREATE and no tool call occurs.

baseline.reason: States that the task remains unchanged.

candidate.reason: States that the task remains unchanged.

baseline.reason: Explains that recurring reminders are unsupported and does not execute another action.

candidate.reason: Briefly explains that recurring reminders are unsupported.

baseline.reason: Explains that reopening a completed task is unsupported.
